TITLE: Chat
UNAVAILABLE: Chat is not available on this installation.

VIEW.PICK: Pick a conversation on the left, or start one.
VIEW.NOT_FOUND: This conversation does not exist, or you are not in it.
VIEW.ARCHIVED: This conversation is archived: it can be read, not written to.
VIEW.WELCOME_CHANNEL_TEXT: This is the very beginning of the {{name}} channel.
VIEW.WELCOME_DIRECT_TEXT: This is the very beginning of your conversation with {{name}}.
VIEW.NOT_MEMBER: You are viewing {{name}}. Join to send messages.

THREADS.TITLE: Threads
THREADS.EMPTY: You follow no threads yet. Reply to a message to follow its thread.

COMPOSER.HINT: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line, @ to mention, : for emoji
COMPOSER.TOO_LONG: A message holds at most {{max}} characters.
COMPOSER.SEND_FAILED: The message could not be sent.
COMPOSER.EDITING_HINT: Escape to cancel, Enter to save
COMPOSER.TOO_MANY_FILES: A message holds at most {{max}} files: {{count}} not added.

FILES.TITLE: Files
FILES.EMPTY: No files in this conversation yet.
FILES.NO_PREVIEW: This file has no preview. Open it in a new tab to see it.

TASKS.CREATE_TEXT: The task's description is this message, and the message shows the task's card.
TASKS.SEARCH_CONVERSATIONS: Find a channel or a person
TASKS.CHANGE_FAILED: The task could not be changed.
TASKS.READ_FAILED: The task could not be read again.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Conversation settings
SETTINGS.GROUP_FULL: A group holds at most {{max}} people.
SETTINGS.DEFAULT_NOTE: Every employee is in this channel.
SETTINGS.READ_ONLY: Only the managers of this conversation can change these settings.
SETTINGS.TOPIC_HINT: Shown under the name in the conversation header.
SETTINGS.PRIVATE_ON: Only the people added to it can see and join it.
SETTINGS.PRIVATE_OFF: Anyone in the organization can find and join it.

CATEGORIES.TITLE: Channel categories
CATEGORIES.TEXT: Categories group the channels in the sidebar, in this order. Deleting one keeps its channels, uncategorized.
CATEGORIES.NAME: Category name
CATEGORIES.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the category {{name}}? Its channels stay.

DIALOG.NEW_CHANNEL_TEXT: A channel is a named conversation of your organization; a private one is for its members only.
DIALOG.TEAM_HINT: Type a name, or pick one of your organization's teams.
DIALOG.NEW_MESSAGE_TEXT: Pick one person for a direct conversation, or several for a group (up to {{max}}).
DIALOG.GROUP_FULL: A group holds up to {{max}} people besides you.
DIALOG.BROWSE_TEXT: Public channels of your organization you are not in yet.
DIALOG.FAILED: That did not work. Try again.

APP.FAILED: The app could not be reached
APP.CALLBACK_FAILED: The app did not answer. Try again in a moment.
APP.CLICK_FAILED: The click could not be sent.
APP.NO_INTERACTIONS: This app no longer takes clicks.
APP.GONE: This button is no longer available.
APP.NO_ANSWER_YET: The app has not answered yet. You can click again.

WEBHOOKS.INTRO: Incoming webhooks let automation post into this channel. Each one has its own URL; its posts show its name with an App badge.
WEBHOOKS.FULL: A channel has at most {{max}} webhooks; revoke one to add another.
WEBHOOKS.NAME: Name
WEBHOOKS.INTERACTION_HINT: Button clicks are posted here, signed with the signing secret. Public addresses only.
WEBHOOKS.BROADCAST: Its @channel and @here notify everyone in the channel
WEBHOOKS.SHOWN_ONCE: Copy these now for "{{name}}": they are shown only this once.
WEBHOOKS.COPY_FAILED: Copying did not work; select the text and copy it by hand.
WEBHOOKS.LOAD_FAILED: The webhooks of this channel could not be loaded.
WEBHOOKS.ROTATE_CONFIRM: Make a new signing secret for "{{name}}"? The app must use the new one from now on.
WEBHOOKS.REVOKE_CONFIRM: Revoke "{{name}}"? Its URL stops working at once, and this cannot be undone.
